currentRecommendedBaseline.rationale: DOW (Monday) + direction (Long) are both ex-ante at entry time. No lookahead. No parameter fitting on price levels. Reduces trade count 90% while preserving edge.
currentRecommendedBaseline.pbValidation: 9/9 WF folds positive, OOS CAGR 19.27%, Sharpe 1.33-1.44 across combinations

filterCandidates.name: Session Filter
filterCandidates.definition: Only trade during European session (06:00-18:00 CET) or NY overlap (13:00-17:00 CET)

filterCandidates.name: Day-of-Week Filter
filterCandidates.definition: Trade only on specific days: Mon/Tue/Wed/Thu/Fri
filterCandidates.note: E6_MonLong already uses Monday. This tests other days or combinations.

filterCandidates.name: Month/Quarter Filter
filterCandidates.definition: Trade only in specific months or quarters

filterCandidates.name: Long/Short Asymmetry
filterCandidates.definition: Long-only vs short-only vs both directions
filterCandidates.note: E6_MonLong already uses LONG_ONLY. Short-only should be tested separately.

filterCandidates.name: ATR Threshold Filter
filterCandidates.definition: Only enter trade when 14-period ATR(30m) at entry bar close exceeds threshold X pips
filterCandidates.rationale: ATR directly proxies expected move per trade. If ATR < cost-equivalent threshold, the trade cannot cover costs in expectation. Completely ex-ante (ATR computed at bar close before entry). Expected to improve cost efficiency further by eliminating low-volatility churn.

filterCandidates.name: Higher-Timeframe Trend Filter
filterCandidates.definition: Only trade in direction of 4H EMA slope at entry

filterCandidates.name: ADX Trend Strength Filter
filterCandidates.definition: Only trade when ADX(14) on 2H chart > threshold at entry bar

filterCandidates.name: Volatility Regime Filter
filterCandidates.definition: Trade only when 20-period 30m volatility (std dev of returns) > median historical volatility

filterCandidates.name: Cooldown Filter
filterCandidates.definition: Minimum N bars between consecutive entries

filterCandidates.name: Time Stop / Max Hold Filter
filterCandidates.definition: Exit position after N bars if not stopped out or at target

filterCandidates.name: Cost Hurdle Filter
filterCandidates.definition: Only enter if expected gross edge (from signal score or historical avg) > N × roundturn cost
filterCandidates.expectedTradeReduction_pct: variable — depends on signal score availability
filterCandidates.dataRequired: signal scoring mechanism or calibrated edge estimate per filter bucket

filterCandidates.name: Signal Strength / Confidence Filter
filterCandidates.definition: Only trade when composite signal confidence exceeds threshold

filterCandidates.name: Spread Proxy Filter
filterCandidates.definition: Skip entry if estimated spread (bar range proxy) > 0.5 pips at entry time

filterCandidates.name: Minimum Prior Day Range Filter
filterCandidates.definition: Skip if prior trading day H-L range < threshold pips
filterCandidates.dataRequired: daily OHLC for 6E (prior day available at entry)

filterCandidates.name: Macro Regime Filter (VIX Proxy)
filterCandidates.definition: Skip entries when risk regime is adverse (VIX > threshold or risk-off proxy active)
filterCandidates.dataRequired: VIX daily close or risk-off index in Brain
